info.title: CosmicForge Pharmacy Payment & Wallet API
info.description:
Invoice management, pharmacy wallet, patient payment, escrow, and dispute resolution for Cosmic Pharmacy.

**Currency:** All amounts stored internally in USD. Returned to clients in their local currency based on location. Falls back to USD for unsupported currencies.

**Escrow:** Online payments are held in escrow (pendingClearance) for 1–3 business days before moving to availableBalance. Cash/POS payments credited immediately.

post.description: Creates a draft invoice for a prescription. Amounts submitted in pharmacy's local currency (e.g. NGN). Draft invoices do NOT change prescription status.

403.description: Prescription does not belong to this pharmacy

get.summary: List all invoices for the pharmacy

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search patient name, invoice ref, or prescription ref

patch.description: Only allowed when status is 'draft'. Returns 422 if already sent or paid.

422.description: Invoice is not in draft status

post.description: Changes status from draft → sent. Notifies patient. Sets prescription → awaiting_payment. Sets dueAt to 7 days from now if not already set.

422.description: Invoice is not in draft status

patch.description: Cannot cancel a paid invoice. If prescription was awaiting_payment, reverts to under_review.

patch.summary: Mark a pay_on_pickup invoice as paid
patch.description: Manually confirms cash/POS payment. Credits pharmacy wallet immediately (no escrow hold). Sets prescription → in_progress.

422.description: Not a pay_on_pickup invoice, or already paid/cancelled

get.description: Returns balances, earnings, and last payout info in the pharmacy's display currency.

get.summary: Get earnings summary and period breakdown

post.description: Minimum payout: USD 5 equivalent. Amount ≤ availableBalance. Only one active payout at a time.

422.description: Insufficient balance or active payout already exists

patch.description: Only works when status is 'pending'. Restores amount to availableBalance.

422.description: Payout is not in pending status

post.description: Verifies account via Paystack Resolve API and creates a transfer recipient. First account is automatically set as default.

patch.summary: Set a bank account as default

delete.description: Cannot delete default account if others exist. Cannot delete if a payout to this account is pending/processing.

422.description: Cannot delete default account or account with active payout

post.summary: Submit response to an open dispute
post.description: Only when dispute status is 'open' or 'under_review'. Automatically advances status from open → under_review.

422.description: Dispute is not open or under_review

get.summary: List invoices for the authenticated patient
get.description: Returns invoices including pharmacyName and pharmacyLogo. Amounts in patient's local currency.
Includes pharmacyName, pharmacyAddress, pharmacyPhone, paidAt, dueAt, all line items.

patch.description: Call when patient opens the invoice detail screen. Advances status from sent → viewed.

post.summary: Raise a dispute on a paid invoice
post.description: Only allowed on paid invoices within 7 days of payment.

422.description: Invoice not paid or dispute window closed

post.description: Returns a gateway redirect URL. Idempotent — if a pending payment exists for the invoice, returns it. Rate limited: max 5 attempts per invoice per hour. Currency is resolved from patient's location (USD fallback for unsupported currencies).

422.description: Invoice not in a payable status

get.summary: Verify payment after returning from gateway
get.description: Fallback for when the webhook is delayed. The webhook remains the primary confirmation mechanism. If the gateway confirms success and the invoice is not yet marked paid, this endpoint processes the payment atomically.

post.description:
Internal endpoint — called by Paystack or Flutterwave, not by the frontend. Signature is validated before processing.

**Events handled:**
- `charge.success` → invoice paid, prescription in_progress, wallet credited (escrow)
- `transfer.success` → payout completed
- `transfer.failed` / `transfer.reversed` → payout failed, funds restored

get.description: Returns transaction details suitable for a receipt. Amount returned in pharmacy display currency.
Returns balance, total spent, and total top-ups in the patient local display currency.
